command:
make e2e >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; start=$(date +%s); out=$(make e2e 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$out"; exit 1; }; d=$(( $(date +%s) - start )); case "$out" in *'e2e summary:'*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac; echo "e2e duration ${d}s"; [ "$d" -le 120 ]
